schema.claim: the mistaken interpretation as it was stated
schema.made: date the claim was made (2026-09-dd; approximate where ~)
schema.survival_h: approximate hours from made to caught (order-of-magnitude where the record has only dates)
schema.source: where the claim and its correction are recorded
schema.earliest_catch: the earliest cheap measurement that would have caught it
schema.caught_by: self | other_seat | fresh_worker | audit | test | operator

classes.MAV: measured after the world's own variation operator (NEW; sub-class of SIM)
classes.IDA: identical-arms defect read as a null
classes.PHT: post-hoc threshold / plug-in baseline / post-hoc subgroup
classes.RCF: ruler/guard that cannot fire (or cannot refuse)
classes.SUM: summary sourced from a summary, not the record (NEW)
classes.ABS: missing field / absent instrument read as a negative (no third outcome) (NEW)
